name: value-pricing
description: A value-based pricing workflow that triangulates market, cost and buyer value, analyzes transaction-based demand associations, and turns the evidence into testable package hypotheses.

interface.longDescription: Run a structured pricing study for a product or service. The skill gathers feature evidence, compares competitor prices, models customer value and delivery costs, can estimate segment-level transaction quantity price associations with Bayesian partial pooling, convenes a persona council, and proposes packages with a real-buyer validation plan. Observational demand estimates are not causal without a defensible identification design. Simulated-buyer outputs are hypotheses, not demand forecasts or substitutes for customer research. Python analysis scripts need a local shell and Python 3.11 or later.
defaultPrompt: Help me estimate a defensible price for this product.
Design three pricing tiers from our value drivers and costs.
What evidence do we need before we raise our prices?
